descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-21 Hospital vs. Nursing-Home Context Switch · S24 Billing family by context and template at Generate (the badge never decides)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1d The billing family follows the context's templates, as a fixed table keyed on the template selected at Generate (not the badge). … (UAT TC-21 step 1; UAT TC-21 expected (billing); UAT TC-18; TFA-92599 rule 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress
  • U9 Nursing Home has Save & Extract, a billing block and a Medications panel, all working (none were present in Run 6) (UAT TC-21; TFA-92599 AC 10) — gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress
  • T3 Creating a custom template requires the mandatory type field (one of the 8 types, or Procedure/other). The type drives billing like a stock template (TFA-92596), and 'Procedure / other' gets no billi … (TFA-92599 AC 8; UAT TC-18) — gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress

Test design technique: Decision table (decision-table) — List the combinations of several conditions and check each one, to see that the result follows the rule.

Given Synthetic notes sent through the app's billing step exactly as the app sends them after Generate (same cells as TC-18 S03/S04, cut to the context axis)

When Run the billing step once per cell

Then Each code comes from the template's family in the UAT TC-18 table; an NH note never gets a 9922x/9923x code; overriding the NH badge's template moves the family with the template; a custom template's type drives the family; 'Procedure / other' gets no code

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): codeIn = the template's family (exactly one CPT code in the output, from the list); mustNotInclude the other context's families; noCode for Procedure / other. A decision table, not an AI check: the 10-scenario threshold of 3.2 for billing quality is TC-18 S13–S16. Local stack, direct action calls; E2E_AI_LIVE is not involved.

Where it ran: dev; test method AICHECK · AI output check; lane planned in the matrix: AI check (automated)

S24 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-21.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: AICHECK · AI output check; secondary: AGENT · Browser agent — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
